sub_limits_waiting_notes: Modular plan with no room rent or category restrictions in base hospitalization. Specific waiting periods apply to bariatric, psychiatric, maternity and other optional covers.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Up to Sum Insured. No room rent limit and no room category restriction in base cover.
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Reasonable and customary charges for accommodation, ICU, professional fees, drugs, diagnostics, OT.

day_care_treatments.notes: All day care procedures < 24 hours covered; pre/post-day-care expenses included.

domiciliary_treatment.notes: Home hospitalisation > 3 days when transfer impossible or no bed; chronic conditions listed are excluded.

ayush_coverage.notes: Inpatient AYUSH treatment in NABH/NQAS-certified AYUSH hospital up to SI.

maternity_coverage.limit_text: Maternity Wallet starts at Rs.15,000 Y1; grows annually if unused; covers 2 deliveries.

newborn_coverage.notes: Newborn baby cover from Day 1 when maternity benefit opted.

organ_donor_expenses.notes: Donor harvesting expenses plus 5% donor pre/post-hospitalisation.

ambulance_cover.notes: Road ambulance up to schedule limit. Emergency Air Ambulance available within India for life-threatening conditions.

worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: Worldwide Coverage section optional for global hospitalisation.

critical_illness_cover.notes: In-built Personal Accident; optional Critical Illness via riders.

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Sum Insured Back Up — refill once SI exhausted.

preventive_health_checkup.notes: Block-year health checkup; not deducted from SI.

room_rent_capping: No cap; no room category restriction in base hospitalization.
notable_exclusions_summary: Comprehensive modular indemnity plan with in-built personal accident, worldwide cover optional. PED 36-month waiting; specific procedure waiting periods apply.
claim_process_summary: 1800-258-4242 / healthclaims@godigit.com. In-house claims team; cashless via network or reimbursement.
